topics: Evaluation and benchmarking of large language models

focus_areas.name: LLM evaluation
focus_areas.tier_a: New benchmarks, evaluation methodology, contamination or reliability studies for LLMs.
focus_areas.tier_b: Dataset papers and surveys with an evaluation angle; general training methods that report careful evaluations.

focus_areas.name: Retrieval and long context
focus_areas.tier_a: New retrieval-augmented architectures; analyses of how models use long contexts.
focus_areas.tier_b: Embedding and reranking methods; efficient attention for long inputs.
